# Golden movement traces of the mobs of Project-Poseidon (Beta 1.7.3).
#
# Every line is the state of one mob after one tick:
#   tick x y z motX motY motZ yaw pitch onGround fallDistance target pathLen pathHash
#
# The traces are produced by the reference implementation itself, the flintcore
# port has to reproduce them tick by tick (no tolerance).
#
# Regenerate (from the repo root, the reference sources have to be compiled into
# target/poseidon_classes once, see DEVELOPMENT.md section 6):
#   javac -nowarn -cp "target/poseidon_classes:.references/Project-Poseidon/libs/*" \
#       -d target/poseidon_classes tools/poseidon_mobs/PoseidonMobTrace.java
#   for s in flat chase water wall lava slime squid ghast; do
#     java -cp "target/poseidon_classes:.references/Project-Poseidon/libs/*" \
#       flintcore.test.PoseidonMobTrace $s 12345 /tmp/mob_traces/$s.txt 300
#   done
#
# The scenarios (the floor of the scenario is grass, the sky light above the
# floor is 15; the harness sets the light by hand, see the README):
#   flat   a pig that wanders on a flat grass floor
#   chase  a zombie that climbs a one block step towards a player
#   water  a zombie that walks into a pool of water
#   wall   a spider that climbs a wall towards a player
#   lava   a zombie that walks into a pool of lava
#   slime  a slime that hops around
#   squid  a squid that swims in a tank of water
#   ghast  a ghast that flies over a flat floor
=== scenario flat ===
# scenario=flat seed=12345 ticks=300 mob=EntityPig
# tick x y z motX motY motZ yaw pitch onGround fallDistance target pathLen pathHash
